Maya: Heads up — Geraldine the mail goose photobombed the mailroom camera this morning. pic: https://i.imgur.com/6YpQk8r.jpg
Sam: NO WAY :goose: she looks like a tiny postal manager.
Jules: LOL that stare. Is she allowed near packages? :eyes:
Priya: Geraldine is on a rotation with facilities today — she insists on inspecting envelopes.
Maya: @Priya honestly she pecked at a bubble mailer and then strutted away like she had approved it.
Sam: Can we get a tiny USPS hat for her? :joy:
Jules: I vote yes. Also: who do I talk to about bringing snacks for the mail goose? 🤔
Priya: @office-bot tag: facilities — Geraldine snack fund?
office-bot: Noted. Reminder: please don't feed any animals near the secure storage area.
Sam: Fine. I will bring very respectable, non-secure breadcrumbs. :bread:
Maya: Update: she waddled into the kitchen and tried to swipe a croissant. Witnesses: @Sam @Jules.
Jules: I have photographic evidence. Uploading now. (two more pics)
Priya: 10/10 would approve Geraldine as official mascot. :thumbsup:
Sam: Petition to add a ‘Geraldine merch’ Slack emoji?
Maya: +1 — merch ideas: tiny mailbag keychain, goose beanie.
Jules: Also, Geraldine's demands: more hats, fewer Monday meetings.
Priya: Meeting rule accepted. :party_popper:
